cohort: Newborns diagnosed with DDH at Abha Maternity and Children Hospital, Abha, Saudi Arabia between 2016 and 2023
finding: While positive family history of DDH was a significant risk factor, breech presentation was not significantly associated with DDH in preterm children, and no significant associations were found between complications during pregnancy and other factors.
mod_finding: The difference in complication rates between women who delivered via C-section and those who delivered vaginally was insignificant.
